{{Quote|Most Evocii are decent, though not too bright. Like my little helper here. Say hello, Imot.|Var'soonta|<ref name="Trophy" />}}
'''Imot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Evocii]] and assistant to the salvage dealer [[Var'soonta]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He implored an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial-aligned]] individual to assist his people by dealing with a [[Horell|hunter]] who slaughtered Evocii.
